Search OpenNeuro datasets

Source: R/search.R
search_datasets.Rd

Search for datasets on OpenNeuro using the advanced search API. Supports filtering by modality, species, task, and other BIDS fields.

search_datasets(
  modality = NULL,
  species = NULL,
  task = NULL,
  diagnosis = NULL,
  sex = NULL,
  min_subjects = NULL,
  max_subjects = NULL,
  bids_dataset_type = NULL,
  brain_initiative = NULL,
  study_domain = NULL,
  body_part = NULL,
  author = NULL,
  keywords = NULL,
  ...,
  n = 20,
  order_by = NULL
)

Arguments

modality

Filter by imaging modality (e.g. "mri", "pet", "eeg").

species

Filter by species (e.g. "Human", "Mouse").

task

Filter by task name (e.g. "stroop", "rest").

diagnosis

Filter by diagnosis.

sex

Filter by sex ("male", "female", "both").

min_subjects

Minimum number of subjects.

max_subjects

Maximum number of subjects.

bids_dataset_type

BIDS dataset type ("raw" or "derivative").

brain_initiative

Filter for Brain Initiative datasets.

study_domain

Filter by study domain.

body_part

Filter by body part.

author

Filter by author name.

keywords

Free-text keywords.

...

Additional search parameters passed to the API.

n

Maximum number of datasets to return.

order_by

Sort order. One of "name", "created", "downloads", "stars", "views".

Value

A tibble with one row per dataset.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
search_datasets(modality = "mri", n = 5)
search_datasets(task = "stroop", min_subjects = 50)
} # }
